article.title: Guarantee on contract that creditor shall not act on it until co-surety joins.
article.content: Where a person gives a guarantee upon a contract that the creditor shall not act upon it until another person has joined in it as co-surety, the guarantee is not valid if that other person does not join.
article.html:
144Guarantee on contract that creditor shall not act on it until co-surety joins.

Section 144 · Chapter VIII · page 38 of the Act

Where a person gives a guarantee upon a contract that the creditor shall not act upon it until another person has joined in it as co-surety, the guarantee is not valid if that other person does not join.
